title: GOAL
description: Where a human enters the system. An outcome and its envelope - not a department to run, and not a change to make.

outcome.description: What must become true. Not a feature, not a task.

owner.description: The accountable human. A goal with no owner has no one to escalate to.

measure.description: How anyone would know it happened. If this cannot be written, the goal is a wish.

budget.description: Time, money or compute. An unbounded goal cannot be traded off against another.

constraints.description: Hard limits on how it may be achieved.

prohibited.description: Outcomes that are failures even if the measure is met. The half nobody writes down.

risk.description: Consequence class, independent of reversibility - see departments/release.md.

serves.description: What this goal acts on, when it is not new ground. A goal closing an open register finding routes straight to Engineering - the second queue - rather than through Discovery, which decides whether to build things nobody has decided on.
